dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Ah, he's the one at Xochicuicatl Records.

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: Have you been? Although Pakaa isn't the most reliable guy, he's got good taste, and they even carry some of my records.

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: There are tracks that you can listen to for free. Don't miss out!

dialogues.speaker: Milu Nui
dialogues.text: ...Oh and, please let me know what you think after you've listened to it. Like... does my music really sound like it's meant for children?
